# pve_cluster_qdevice (Resource)

Corosync QDevice of the cluster (`pvecm qdevice setup`). **Requires the provider's `ssh` block**: the Proxmox VE API can only report QDevice status, so this resource runs `/usr/bin/pvecm qdevice setup` and `remove` on `node` over SSH (as `root`, or through `sudo -n` — see the SSH guide for the exact sudoers rule). `pvecm` needs `corosync-qnetd` on the QNet host, `corosync-qdevice` on every node, all nodes online, and root SSH access from `node` to the QNet host. Destroying the resource runs `pvecm qdevice remove`.

Import with `<node>/<address>`, for example `pve01/10.0.0.50`. `network` and `force` are not recoverable from the cluster, so they stay unset after an import; omit them in the configuration or accept the replacement they trigger.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_cluster_qdevice" "example" {
  node    = "pve1"
  address = "10.0.0.50"
  force   = true # needed for an odd node count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address of the host running `corosync-qnetd`. `pvecm` accepts only an IP address, not a hostname.
- `node` (String) Cluster member that runs `pvecm`.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Pass `--force`. `pvecm` refuses to set up a QDevice for a cluster with an odd node count without it.
- `network` (String) CIDR of the network `corosync-qdevice` uses to reach the QNet daemon (`--network`).

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Decision algorithm in use, for example `Fifty-Fifty split`.
- `id` (String) The QNet daemon address.
- `model` (String) QDevice model, for example `Net`.
- `qnetd_host` (String) QNet daemon endpoint (`host:port`) the QDevice reports.
- `state` (String) QDevice connection state, for example `Connected`.
- `tie_breaker` (String) Tie-breaker setting reported by the QDevice.
